d: Ashutosh Ranka, speaking at the Sala Kithe Mova event in Goa, highlights the struggles of communities across India to protect their land, forests, water resources and cultural identities. Drawing parallels between Goa and Rajasthan, he speaks about the alleged diversion of Tribal Sub-Plan funds, changes to the definition of the Aravalli hills, and the growing threats to indigenous communities. He urges Goans to take the lead in protecting their identity and deciding the future of their State, rather than allowing outsiders or Delhi to dictate its direction.
